_meta.description: Curated Sigiriya visitor-trail landmarks not tagged under their popular names in the base OpenStreetMap GeoPackage (assets/vectors/sigiriya_map.gpkg). This layer is additive only — the base map is never modified. Coordinates are anchored to the nearest real surveyed OSM feature, not invented; see 'anchor_source' on each entry. Mirrored in code at frontend/lib/features/map/heritage_map_screen.dart (_curatedTrailStops) — keep both in sync if edited.

pois.name: Ticket Counter
pois.description: The official Sigiriya site entrance ticket office. Open 7:00am-5:00pm daily; foreign-visitor ticket price and hours per Central Cultural Fund (CCF).
pois.source: OpenStreetMap (bundled GeoPackage) — real surveyed point 'Sigiriya site ticket office'; hours/price cross-checked against CCF eTicketing (eservices.ccf.gov.lk)

pois.name: Water Gardens
pois.description: Symmetrical water-garden complex on the western approach: an island pavilion reached by four causeways, twin pools with limestone fountains still functional in the rainy season, and an octagonal pool. First zone on the visitor trail after the entrance.
pois.source: Wikipedia (Sigiriya article, summarizing published archaeological surveys/UNESCO documentation) for the description; coordinate anchored to a real unnamed leisure=park polygon on the entrance approach in the base GeoPackage (OSM has no feature literally named 'Water Gardens')
pois.anchor_source: OSM polygon (unnamed), no OSM name to reuse — position approximate to the garden zone

pois.name: Boulder Gardens & Cobra Hood Cave
pois.description: Boulders linked by winding paths across the rock's northern/southern slopes, once topped by pavilions (cuttings for brick walls/beams are still visible) and doubling as a defensive line. Cobra Hood Cave, in this stretch, preserves a fragment of the original ceiling fresco.
pois.source: Wikipedia (Sigiriya article) for the description; coordinate is the real OSM point 'Cobra Hood Cave'

pois.name: Terraced Gardens
pois.description: Concentric, brick-walled terraces rising from the boulder gardens, reached by limestone staircases, leading up to the rock's base and the lion staircase entrance.
pois.source: Wikipedia (Sigiriya article) for the description; no OSM feature is tagged with this name
pois.anchor_source: Interpolated 40% between Cobra Hood Cave and Lion's Paw Terrace (both real OSM points) — approximates the described position, not a surveyed coordinate

pois.name: Mirror Wall & Fresco Gallery
pois.description: Polished brick-and-plaster wall (once mirror-bright) beside the spiral staircase, inscribed with visitor poetry from the 8th-10th centuries. The nearby rock face carried a 140m x 40m gallery of apsara (celestial nymph) frescoes, of which a handful survive.
pois.source: Wikipedia (Sigiriya article) for the description; no OSM feature is tagged with either name
pois.anchor_source: Interpolated 65% between Cobra Hood Cave and Lion's Paw Terrace (both real OSM points), matching the described location on the ascent — not a surveyed coordinate

pois.name: Audience Hall & Throne
pois.description: A large boulder carved into an audience chamber with a rock-cut throne, at the rock's base within the boulder-garden zone — distinct from (and lower than) the summit palace ruins.
pois.source: OpenStreetMap (bundled GeoPackage) — real surveyed point 'Audience Hall' tagged tourism=attraction; description cross-checked against general published Sigiriya site literature

pois.name: Summit Palace
pois.description: Royal residence ruins on the rock's flat summit (built for King Kashyapa I, 477-495 CE), including rock-cut cisterns for water storage. Reached past Lion's Paws at the top of the final ascent.
pois.source: Wikipedia (Sigiriya article) for the description; coordinate anchored to the real OSM point/polygon 'Upper Terrace' (summit level, tagged tourism=viewpoint)
pois.anchor_source: OSM point 'Upper Terrace', exact coordinate — used as the summit-ruins anchor since no feature is literally named 'Summit Palace'

not_duplicated_from_base_map: Lion's Paws / Lion Platform — already an accurately-placed named OSM point in the base GeoPackage; only its display priority was elevated, not duplicated here.

Sigiriya (Lion Rock / archaeological site), Sigiriya Museum, Sigiriya Tank, Pidurangala Rock, Pidurangala Vihara, Mapagala Rock, Mapagala Archaeological Site, Ramakale Stupa, Sigiriya Entrance Bus Station — all already present and named in the base GeoPackage; elevated to always-shown priority in the renderer rather than duplicated as custom POIs.

Toilets, drinking water, parking, restaurants, cafes, hotels, guest houses, police, first aid/doctors, ATMs, bicycle rental, souvenir/convenience shops, tourist information, bus stops — all already tagged in the base GeoPackage (amenity/shop/tourism columns) and rendered directly from it with dedicated icons; see frontend/lib/features/map/heritage_map_screen.dart _pointMarkerStyle / _polygonMarkerStyle.
